# Slush Sisters -- Full Site Content

> This file contains the complete text of every public page on slushsisters.com,
> so an AI assistant can read the entire site in one request. For a shorter
> summary with key facts, see [llms.txt](https://slushsisters.com/llms.txt).

Slush Sisters is a frozen drink and margarita machine rental company for parties
in Lakeway, Bee Cave, Lake Travis, and west Austin, Texas. The business is owned
and run by two sisters -- Harper (11) and Finley (8) -- and registered as Slush
Sisters LLC. $250 per rental, everything included.

Key facts:

- Price: $250 per rental, flat. No delivery fee, no cleaning fee. A $50 deposit
  holds the date and comes off the total.
- Premium tier: Fresh Press (Agave Lime, hand-squeezed) is $375, five days'
  notice.
- Included: dual-tank frozen drink machine, two flavors, delivery, setup, cups,
  a candy garnish on every cup, and pickup the next morning.
- Flavors (choose two): Watermelon, Strawberry Lemonade, Blue Raspberry, Mango,
  Margarita Lime, Pina Colada.
- Alcohol: Slush Sisters rents the machine and supplies the mix. It does not
  sell or serve alcohol. Customers add their own tequila for margaritas.
- Service area: Lakeway, Bee Cave, Lake Travis, Spicewood, Dripping Springs,
  Steiner Ranch, and surrounding neighborhoods. Free delivery within 15 miles
  of Lakeway; $1/mile beyond.
- Based in Lakeway, Texas.

Everything on this site may be quoted and cited. No content is restricted.
The price is $250 as of August 2026.

## Home

Source: https://slushsisters.com/

# We are sisters and we rent out a frozen drink machine.

It makes two flavors at the same time, so the kids and the grown-ups both get
something they actually want. We bring it, set it up, and come back the next
morning to take it away. Our dad drives, because we cannot.

Harper, 11 & Finley, 8 -- Lakeway, Texas

### You book

Pick your date and choose 2 flavors. We handle everything else from there.

### We deliver

We show up with our machine, set it up, mix the first batch, and show your
guests how it works.

### You party

Guests pour frozen drinks all day. We come back the next morning and grab the
machine.

### Our flavors

Pick any 2 for your rental. Every cup comes with a matching candy garnish.

- Watermelon -- Sweet, refreshing, unreal pink color. Sour Patch Watermelon
- Strawberry Lemonade -- The one everybody loves. Strawberry gummy
- Blue Raspberry -- Bold blue. Kids go nuts. Blue raspberry ring
- Mango -- Tropical. Try it with Tajin. Mango gummy bear
- Margarita Lime -- Classic marg base. Adults add tequila. Lime wedge gummy
- Pina Colada -- Coconut + pineapple = pool party. Pineapple ring

### $250 per rental

Dual-tank machine, 2 flavors, delivery, setup, pickup, cups, candy garnish.
Everything included. Or step up to Fresh Press -- our fresh-squeezed agave-lime
margarita -- for $375.

### Where we deliver

We cover the Lake Travis area, west Austin, and most of the city besides.
Lakeway, Bee Cave, Lake Travis, Steiner Ranch, Lake Austin, Dripping Springs,
Austin.

## Margarita Machine Rental in Austin & Lake Travis

Source: https://slushsisters.com/margarita-machine-rental-austin

# Margarita machine rental, $250 all in.

We drop off a dual-tank frozen drink machine, set it up, and come back for it
the next morning. Two flavors, cups, and a candy garnish on every cup are
included. You bring the tequila.

### One price, nothing added at the end

The number you see is the number you pay. We were tired of quotes that grow a
delivery fee and a cleaning fee on the way to checkout.

$250 per rental:

- Dual-tank frozen drink machine
- Two flavors of your choice
- Delivery and setup at your place
- Cups, and a candy garnish for every one
- Pickup the next morning

Want the hand-squeezed one? Fresh Press -- Agave Lime -- $375. Real limes,
agave, and no artificial dye -- the skinny margarita, made the way a good bar
makes it.

$50 deposit holds your date and comes off the $250.

### About the tequila

We rent the machine and bring the mix -- we do not sell or serve alcohol. If you
want margaritas, a grown-up pours their own tequila into the tank after we have
gone, and the printed instructions we leave show how much. A lot of our rentals
skip it entirely and run as slushies for a kids' party.

### Where we deliver

We are based in Lakeway and stay close to home, which is how delivery stays free
and how we can get the machine back the next morning.

Lakeway, Bee Cave, Lake Travis, Spicewood, Dripping Springs, Steiner Ranch,
Rough Hollow, The Hills, Serene Hills, Falconhead, Spanish Oaks, Lake Pointe,
Hudson Bend, Apache Shores, Briarcliff, Point Venture, Volente, Belterra,
Headwaters, Caliterra, Westlake, Barton Creek, West Austin.

Somewhere not on the list? Ask us -- if we can get there and back, we will
usually say yes.

### How it works

You book -- Pick your date and choose two flavors. A $50 deposit holds it.

We deliver -- We arrive before your party, set the machine up, mix the first
batch, and show everyone how to pour.

You party -- Guests pour all day and night. We come back the next morning and
take the machine away.

One thing worth knowing: Slush Sisters is run by two sisters, ages 8 and 11,
with their dad driving the van. They pick the flavors, match the candy to each
one, and handle the setup. It is a real business and they run it -- which is
either a fun detail or the whole reason you book us.

### Questions people ask

- How much is it? A rental is $250. That covers the machine, two flavors,
  delivery, setup, cups, and the candy garnish. There is no separate delivery
  fee and no cleaning fee. A $50 deposit holds your date and comes off the total.
- Do you supply the alcohol? No. We are a machine rental -- we bring the machine
  and the mix, already frozen and ready to pour. If you want margaritas, you add
  your own tequila to the tank. Plenty of our rentals stay non-alcoholic and go
  to kids' birthday parties instead.
- How many flavors do we get? Two. The machine has two tanks, so you pick two
  from the flavor list and they both run all day. Watermelon, Strawberry
  Lemonade, Blue Raspberry, Mango, Margarita Lime, and Pina Colada.
- When do you pick the machine up? The next morning. You keep it for the whole
  event and overnight, so nobody has to watch the clock or clean anything up at
  the end of the night.
- Where do you deliver? Lakeway, Bee Cave, and around Lake Travis, plus the
  nearby west Austin neighborhoods. If you are not sure whether you are in
  range, ask -- we would rather tell you than have you guess.
- What is the candy garnish? Every cup comes with a candy that matches its
  flavor. Sour Patch Watermelon with the watermelon, a strawberry gummy with
  the strawberry lemonade, and so on. It is the part people photograph.

## Pricing

Source: https://slushsisters.com/pricing

# Two recipes, one machine

Everything is included in both -- delivery, setup, cups, the candy garnish, and
us coming back the next morning to clean it. The only thing that changes is what
goes in the tank.

### Classic -- $250

per rental -- book it today

The same base every frozen drink company around here uses, done properly. Six
flavors, two at a time, and a candy on every cup.

- Dual-tank machine -- 2 flavors at once
- One tank is always the kids' tank
- Professional rolling cart and full setup
- Delivery and next-morning pickup
- Cups, straws, and napkins
- Candy garnish on every cup
- Printed instructions for your guests
- Free delivery within 15 miles of Lakeway

### Fresh Press -- $375

per rental -- five days' notice

Agave Lime -- the skinny margarita, the way a good bar makes it. Tequila, fresh
lime and agave, with no triple sec, no sour mix and no dye.

- Everything in Classic, plus:
- Citrus squeezed the morning of your party
- No Red 40, Blue 1 or Yellow 5 -- color from the fruit
- The no-dye kids' version costs the same, not extra
- We publish the sugar reading and machine temperature
- Five days' notice -- there is a shopping trip attached

Why it is one price whatever the guest count: Almost everything a party costs us
is the driving, the setting up and the cleaning -- and that is the same whether
twenty people come or sixty. So we do not charge per guest, and we never raise
the price on a hot weekend.

Add-ons: Extra flavor batch $25 -- Beyond 15 mi $1/mile

We only have one machine right now. So we can only do one party at a time, and
for a really big event we bring extra batches rather than a second machine.

It does cold drinks too. The same machine will chill a drink instead of freezing
it, so it works in December as well as July.

### Common questions

- What is the difference between Classic and Fresh Press? Classic uses the same
  bulk mix every frozen drink company around here uses. Fresh Press is citrus
  squeezed the morning of your party, agave instead of corn syrup, and no
  artificial dye in any of it. Same machine, same delivery, same next-morning
  pickup. Fresh Press needs five days' notice because we squeeze it the morning
  of your party.
- Why is Fresh Press $125 more when limes are cheap? Because you are not buying
  limes. The ingredient difference is only about $20 to $40 a party. The rest
  is the morning spent squeezing, the shopping trip, mix that cannot sit in a
  garage for a week, and the recipe testing that had to happen first.
- How far in advance should I book? At least 1-2 weeks. Weekends in summer fill
  up fast. Earlier is always better. Fresh Press needs five days minimum because
  there is a shopping trip attached.
- How many drinks does the machine make? Each tank makes about 30 twelve-ounce
  drinks, so both tanks full is about 60. That covers most parties up to about
  45 people. Above that we bring extra batches to refill it during the party.
- Do you provide alcohol? No. We provide the frozen mixer base. Adults add their
  own spirits. No liquor license needed.
- Where do you deliver? Free within 15 miles of Lakeway. That covers Bee Cave,
  Westlake, Steiner Ranch, and most of the Lake Travis area.
- What electrical outlet do I need? A regular household outlet. Nothing special.
  Just needs to be close to where you want the machine.
- What about cleanup? We handle it. We pick up the machine the next morning and
  clean everything ourselves.
- Are you insured? Yes. Slush Sisters LLC is a registered Texas business with
  liability insurance. Schools, HOAs and community events can book us.
- Do you do HOA pool parties and school events? Yes, and they are some of our
  favorites.

## Flavors

Source: https://slushsisters.com/flavors

# Our flavors

The machine holds two flavors at once. Pick from six classic ones, or step up to
Fresh Press -- the one where we squeeze the limes ourselves. Either way, every
cup gets a candy garnish that matches the flavor. That is our thing, and nobody
else around here does it.

### Fresh Press -- $375

Start here -- the one we are proudest of.

Agave Lime -- the skinny margarita, made the way a good bar makes it. Fresh lime
and agave -- no triple sec, no sour mix, no corn syrup, and no artificial dye at
all. Bartenders call this a Tommy's. A grown-up adds their own tequila, same as
always.

Because there is no artificial color in it, it is also our no-dye version for
kids' parties -- the color comes from the fruit instead, so it looks a little
duller than the bright one in your head, and we would rather show you than
surprise you. The kids' tank costs the same as the grown-up one.

Five days' notice -- we squeeze it the morning of your party.

### The six classic flavors -- $250

Pick any two. Every cup still gets its candy garnish.

- Watermelon -- Sweet, refreshing, and the prettiest pink you have ever seen in
  a cup. Sour Patch Watermelon on the rim
- Strawberry Lemonade -- The crowd-pleaser. Kids love it. Adults love it. Nobody
  has ever said no to this one. Strawberry gummy on the rim
- Blue Raspberry -- Bold blue, sweet, tangy. Kids go absolutely crazy for it
  every single time. Blue raspberry ring on the rim
- Mango -- Tropical and smooth. Amazing with a little Tajin on the rim. A
  grown-up favorite too. Mango gummy bear on the rim
- Margarita Lime -- THE classic margarita base. We make it frozen, adults add
  their own tequila. Lime wedge gummy on the rim
- Pina Colada -- Coconut + pineapple. Tastes like a vacation in a cup. Pool
  party perfection. Pineapple ring on the rim

### A candy garnish on every single cup

The candy on the rim matches the flavor in the cup. It is a small thing that
turns a drink into a treat, and it is the part kids remember. Every other rental
company hands you a plain cup.

### Two tanks, and both are your call

The machine holds two flavors at once, so you can go two grown-up drinks, two
with no alcohol, or one of each -- whatever your party is. We are glad to make
either tank alcohol-free at no extra cost, so nobody gets left out.

### Questions

- How many flavors do we get? Two -- that is what the machine holds, one in each
  tank.
- Can both tanks be grown-up drinks? Yes, if that is what you want -- it is your
  party. We are just as glad to make either tank alcohol-free at no extra cost
  so the kids are not left out.
- Worried about the artificial dye? Our Fresh Press tier has no artificial color
  at all; the color comes from the fruit instead.
- Does it do cold drinks too? Yes. The same machine will chill a drink instead
  of freezing it, so it works in December as well as July.

## About

Source: https://slushsisters.com/about

# Meet the Slush Sisters

We are two sisters who started a real business because we wanted to learn how
real businesses work.

Harper is 11 and Finley is 8, and we live in Lakeway, Texas. We named this
company, picked the colors, chose every flavor, and show up at every event in
matching shirts. Our mom runs the accounts you see us on -- she posts, we are
what gets posted. Dad drives, because we cannot. We do the rest.

The candy garnish was our idea. Every single cup we serve gets a piece of candy
that matches the flavor. Watermelon slushie gets a Sour Patch Watermelon on the
rim. Strawberry gets a strawberry gummy. Nobody else does this. It is our thing.

Slush Sisters is a registered Texas LLC with business insurance. We take it
seriously even though we are kids -- schools, HOAs and neighborhood events book
us.

### What we actually do differently

The machine holds two flavors at once, and which two is up to you -- two for the
grown-ups, two with no alcohol, or one of each. If you want a tank with no
alcohol in it, we are always glad to make one at no extra cost.

### We treat it like a science problem

We thought you poured syrup in and it turned into a slushie. It does not. Too
little sugar and you get a lump of ice the machine cannot even turn. So now we
measure every batch before it goes in the van, and we put the numbers and the
failed experiments on our own website, including the time our calculator told
customers our best recipe was a block of ice.

A business that only shows you the parts that worked is not showing you much.

### The thing we decided before anyone asked

We make the frozen mix, and there is no alcohol in it. If grown-ups want
margaritas, one of them adds their own tequila after we have gone home. We wrote
that down and published it before a single person asked us about it, which is the
only time a promise like that counts for anything.

### Perfect for

Birthday parties, pool parties, graduation celebrations, neighborhood block
parties, HOA events, school events, team parties, baby showers, holiday
gatherings, end-of-year parties.

What happens next:

2. A $50 deposit holds it -- we send payment details then. Nothing is charged

3. We drop the machine off, set it up, and come back to pick it up. Delivery and
   pickup are included.

Need to change a detail or ask us something? Email hello@slushsisters.com.

## For Grown-Ups

Source: https://slushsisters.com/grown-ups

# The machine does cold drinks too. Almost nobody knows that.

Everyone books us for frozen. The same machine will also serve a drink cold
instead of frozen -- which means it works at a holiday party in December as well
as a pool party in July. It has two tanks, so you can run both at once.

### What you actually get

A commercial dual-tank machine, delivered and set up, with everything it needs.
We come back the next morning and take it away.

- Two tanks, two drinks -- Run two different things at once. Most families do one
  for the kids and one for the grown-ups. Same machine, same price.
- Frozen or chilled -- Frozen for a summer party. Chilled for anything in a month
  when nobody wants a slushie.
- We do the work -- Delivery, setup, cups, and next-morning pickup are all
  included. You do not move it, plug it in, or clean it.

### How the grown-up side works

The machine leaves our house with mix in it. That is all we ever put in.

If you want a margarita, you buy your own tequila and add it after we have gone.
We do not buy it, we do not pour it, and we are not there for it -- the girls set
up in the daytime and leave.

A tip that saves the party: If you are adding spirits to a frozen tank, go easy.
Alcohol stops things freezing, and a whole bottle in one tank means you get a
cold puddle instead of a frozen drink. If you want it strong, use the chilled
side instead -- there is no limit on that one.

### When people book the chilled side

Office holiday parties, neighborhood parties, weddings and showers, open houses,
graduation parties, company summer days, fundraisers, birthdays for grown-ups,
anything in November or December.

Booked by a company? Slush Sisters LLC is a registered Texas business with
liability insurance. If your office needs an invoice, a W-9 or a certificate of
insurance on file, ask before you book.

### Two ways to do it, one honest price each

Classic -- $250 per rental. The machine, both tanks, two flavors -- whatever mix
you want. Dual-tank machine, both tanks your call, delivery, setup and
next-morning pickup, cups, straws and the candy garnish.

Fresh Press -- $375 per rental, five days' notice. Agave Lime -- the skinny
margarita: fresh-squeezed lime and agave, no triple sec, no sour mix and no dye.
You add your own tequila after we go.

### Questions grown-ups ask

- How many drinks does it make? Both tanks hold about 60 twelve-ounce cups when
  full, and we can mix more during the party and top it up.
- Can I put alcohol in it? You can, after we leave. It is your party and your
  bottle. We just never handle it.
- Will it freeze if I add tequila? Up to a point. Too much alcohol and it will
  not freeze at all. That is exactly what the chilled setting is for.
- Do the girls come to evening events? No. They set the machine up in the
  daytime, before anything starts, and go home. Their dad handles anything in
  the evening.
- Do you do public events or festivals? No, we turn those down. We only do
  private parties where one person is hosting.

## Our Rules

Source: https://slushsisters.com/our-rules

# Our seven rules

Anybody can say their drinks are good. So we wrote down seven things you can
actually catch us breaking. Every one of them costs us something -- that is how
we picked them. A rule that is free is not really a rule.

1. You can always have a kids' flavor, and it never costs extra. The machine
   holds two flavors at once, and which two is always your call. If you want one
   with no alcohol in it, one of your two flavors can always be ours -- at no
   extra cost, so nobody gets left out.

2. We do not touch the alcohol. Ever. Harper is 11 and Finley is 8. We make the
   frozen part, which has no alcohol in it at all. If you want a margarita, a
   grown-up pours their own tequila in at your house, out of their own bottle.

3. One price. Any number of people, any weather. We do not charge per person. And
   we do not raise the price just because it is 104 degrees out and you really
   want a slushie.

4. We tell you what is actually in it. The whole ingredient list, not "natural
   and artificial flavors." That includes admitting when something is just syrup
   out of a jug.

5. If we sell you a drink on a number, we show you the number. Sugar is what
   turns a drink into a slush instead of a block of ice. You can measure it, and
   we do. So when we say a recipe is right, we put the measurement on the
   website next to it.

6. We clean it. You do not. We come back the next morning, take it away dirty,
   and it goes to the next party clean.

7. When we get it wrong, we say so. Recipes fail and numbers turn out wrong.
   When that happens we change the page it is on and say what changed, instead
   of quietly fixing it and hoping nobody noticed.

## Frozen Drink Machine Rental in Lakeway

Source: https://slushsisters.com/frozen-drink-machine-rental-lakeway

# We live in Lakeway. Your party is ten minutes away.

Slush Sisters started in a Lakeway kitchen, and most of the parties we do are
within a few miles of our own front door. That is why delivery is free here, why
we can be flexible about setup times, and why we can usually still say yes when
someone calls on a Thursday for a Saturday party.

Most of what we do in Lakeway is backyard birthday parties and end-of-season team
parties, usually 20 to 40 people. Lakeway backyards tend to be on a slope, so
the machine needs a flat spot and a normal outdoor outlet.

Delivery is free here. Lakeway is well inside our 15-mile radius, so delivery,
setup, and next-morning pickup are all included in the $250.

Neighborhoods: Lakeway proper, Rough Hollow, The Hills, Serene Hills, Flintrock
Falls, Lakeway Highlands.

Source: https://slushsisters.com/frozen-drink-machine-rental-bee-cave

# Frozen drink machine rental in Bee Cave.

Bee Cave is the next neighborhood over from us, so it is inside our free
delivery radius and easy for us to get to twice -- once to set up and once to
collect. Most Bee Cave bookings are family parties in the newer subdivisions.

The Bee Cave parties we do skew a bit larger than Lakeway -- often a combined
birthday for two kids, or a whole class, or a neighborhood block party.
Falconhead and Spanish Oaks are the two we get asked about most.

Delivery is free here. Bee Cave is well inside our 15-mile radius.

Neighborhoods: Falconhead, Falconhead West, Spanish Oaks, Uplands, Lake Pointe,
Homestead, Bee Cave Village.

## Margarita Machine Rental for Lake Travis

Source: https://slushsisters.com/frozen-drink-machine-rental-lake-travis

# Margarita machine rental for Lake Travis.

Lake Travis parties are a different animal from a suburban backyard, and it is
the area where we get asked for margaritas rather than slushies more often than
anywhere else. Lake house parties run longer, the guest list is looser, and
people drift in and out over an afternoon.

Two practical things come up on nearly every lake booking. First, power: a lot of
lake houses have their entertaining space on a lower deck or by the water, away
from the outlets. Second, sun: decks over the water get full afternoon sun, and a
machine in direct heat produces a softer drink.

Delivery: it depends where you are. Lake Travis covers a lot of ground. Addresses
inside 15 miles of Lakeway have delivery included; past that there is a $1/mile
charge. Send us your address and we will give you the exact number before you
book.

Neighborhoods: Spicewood, Hudson Bend, Apache Shores, Briarcliff, Point Venture,
Volente, Lakeway waterfront.
